newsitem.title: KAZAKHSTAN: Kazakhs scrap refinery deal with Essex Ref Corp.
newsitem.headline: Kazakhs scrap refinery deal with Essex Ref Corp.

text.p: Essex Refinery Corp, registered in the British Virgin Islands, has lost the right to a 53.1 percent stake in Kazakhstan's Atyrau oil refinery, a Kazakh privatisation official said on Friday.
"They (Essex) have not fulfilled their pledges and...the government has prepared documents to terminate the agreement," a senior privatisation official at the finance ministry told reporters.
The company, which won a government tender last month against Geneva-based companies Lia Oil SA and Petroleum Ltd, had promised over $1 billion in investment in the refinery.
Located in the west of the former Soviet republic, Atyrau's annual capacity is 4.5 million tonnes per year and is the only one of three Kazakh refineries that runs entirely on Kazakh feedstock.
The head of state-owned energy concern Kazakh Oil said on Thursday the enterprise would hold the shares in Atyrau until a new tender is announced. He did not say when a new tender might be opened.
